thread:
maria: Heads up — we need a coordinated lockfile + vendor sync before tomorrow's v1.12 cutoff. Two spots to check: 1) submodule pins (services/embeddings, infra/common) and 2) go vendor / python lock regen. If you're touching deps, coordinate here. Run scripts/bump-deps.sh locally and push a vendor-only commit if needed. cc @aj @kevin

aj: On it. I'll update services/embeddings submodule to the pinned commit and open a PR with go mod vendor. ETA ~2h.

kevin: Noted. I ran into a conflict earlier with glide.lock -> we mostly use go modules now, so expect go.mod/go.sum + vendor/ diffs. If anyone sees huge unrelated changes, ping me before merging.

sophia: I can review the changelog + changelog entry requirement: add a single line under Unreleased with a short note (e.g., `deps: vendor bump, submodule pins`). Keep it concise.

release-bot: Reminder: release cutoff for release/v1.12.0 is in ~14 hours. Any dep PRs not merged by cutoff will be deferred to the next patch.

dan: If vendor diffs are enormous, prefer a vendor-only commit with message `chore(vendor): sync deps` so we can easily ignore in feature churn. Also we should avoid rebasing the release branch after vendor commits. :+1:

aj: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4387 — includes submodule update for services/embeddings (pinned to abc1234), `go mod vendor`, and a tiny version bump for proto-tools. PTAL @sophia. CI kicked off.

kevin: When pulling that PR locally, run:
```
git submodule sync && git submodule update --init --recursive --remote services/embeddings
go mod vendor
```
I also added `scripts/sync-vendor.sh` to automate this.

maria: Quick operational note: please don't rebase the release branch while we have vendor artifacts being produced. Use merge commits so CI can cache artifact hashes.

sophia: Reviewed the PR, left a minor formatting nit in CHANGELOG.md (bullet style). Otherwise LGTM. :eyes:

aj: Fixed the changelog formatting and pushed a tiny amend. CI green now. Requesting merge.

release-bot: Merge window open. All required checks passed.

kevin: Merged to release/v1.12.0 and pushed a vendor-only commit. Tagging internal changelog issue #4387. :shipit: 

maria: Awesome — thanks everyone. That should keep the release tidy. Closing thread.
